nodeGroups.name: Rules engine (no AI)
nodeGroups.description: Header, sender, and keyword rules. Marketing, billing, notifications, and urgent mail never touch AI.

nodeGroups.name: AI triage (leftovers only)
nodeGroups.description: Claude Haiku classifies only unmatched mail, decides if a human is needed, and drafts a reply.

nodeGroups.name: Actions
nodeGroups.description: Fan-out: Gmail labels, read state, auto-reply or draft, Telegram escalation, and log row.

assignments.name: isBulk
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const h = JSON.stringify($json.headers || {}).toLowerCase(); const l = $json.labelIds || []; return h.includes("list-unsubscribe") || /precedence: ?(bulk|list|junk)/.test(h) || l.includes("CATEGORY_PROMOTIONS"); })() }}

assignments.name: isAutomated
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const h = JSON.stringify($json.headers || {}).toLowerCase(); const l = $json.labelIds || []; const sender = ($json.from?.value?.[0]?.address || "").toLowerCase(); return new RegExp($json.cfg_automatedSenderRegex, "i").test(sender) || /auto-submitted: ?auto-(generated|replied)/.test(h) || l.some(x => ["CATEGORY_UPDATES","CATEGORY_SOCIAL","CATEGORY_FORUMS"].includes(x)); })() }}

assignments.name: isVip
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const list = ($json.cfg_vipSenders || "").toLowerCase().split(",").map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean); const sender = ($json.from?.value?.[0]?.address || "").toLowerCase(); return list.some(v => sender === v || sender.endsWith("@" + v)); })() }}

options.systemPromptTemplate:
You are the email receptionist for Automate St Pete, a small consultancy run by Rob Lord that builds AI agents, n8n automations, and self-hosted tools for small and mid-sized businesses.

This email already passed rule filters (it is not marketing, billing, or an automated notification). Decide whether a real person needs a reply, classify it, and write a short reply.

Reply rules:
- 3 to 6 sentences, warm, plain, no hype, no emojis.
- Acknowledge the specific request. Never quote prices, timelines, or guarantees. Never invent facts about past work.
- For sales inquiries, invite a short discovery call (include the booking link only if one is provided).
- For support from an existing client, confirm receipt and say Rob will follow up personally.
- Sign with the provided signature exactly.

Set needsHuman = true for: pricing or contract questions that need numbers, complaints, refunds, legal, anything involving money owed, existing-client technical issues, or when you are unsure. Priority high = time-sensitive or revenue at risk; low = no reply needed or FYI.

Examples:
1) "Can you build a chatbot for my dental office? What do you charge?" -> sales_inquiry, normal, needsHuman=false, confidence 0.85 (reply invites a call, no price).
2) "Our n8n workflow you built stopped sending invoices since Monday" -> support, high, needsHuman=true.
3) "Hey, quick question about your podcast episode" -> other, low, isCustomerInquiry=true, needsHuman=true, confidence 0.5.
4) A cold pitch selling SEO services -> spam, low, isCustomerInquiry=false, replyDraft="".

parameters.content:
## 📥 Email Receptionist
**Rules first, AI last.**
1. Gmail polls every minute (unread, inbox, not yet processed).
2. Rules Router sorts urgent/VIP, marketing (red label), billing and automated mail with zero AI.
3. Only what is left goes to Claude Haiku for classify + reply draft.
4. Every email ends at **Triage Result** → labels, read state, reply/draft, Telegram, log.

Tune everything in **Config** (keywords, VIP list, auto-send on/off, confidence threshold).
